In France, the price of a phone is 310 euros.
In Dubai, the price of the same phone is 1185 dirhams.
The exchange rate is 1 euro = 3.95 dirhams.
Find the difference between the two prices.
Give your answer in euros.
........................................ euros [2]
subject: International Mathematics
